provenance: SYNTHETIC DEMO-01 data — not real MOIL operational data

best_action.rationale: Allocate additional development crews and prioritise access headings to increase daily advance.

optimization.method: PuLP CBC — binary selection over counterfactual candidates

constraints: fleet_downtime_h ≥ 10.54 h (p10 of historical daily total)
development_m ≤ 19.59 m/day (p90 of historical daily metres)
All recommendations are single-lever; other features held at baseline

excluded_levers.planned_t: External planning input; not an operational lever
excluded_levers.delay_h: Already 0.0 h in forecast period — no upside available
excluded_levers.shifts: Already at maximum (3 shifts) in forecast period
excluded_levers.lag/rolling: Derived from historical actual_t; not directly controllable

assumptions: Counterfactual scoring uses the PULSE P50 LightGBM model as response surface
Only the target feature is perturbed; all others held at their actual test-period values
Production gain estimated as mean daily prediction difference × 30 days
New shortfall probability estimated using P10/P50/P90 quantile models
Bounds derived from full historical data distributions (p10/p90/p95/max)
One intervention at a time — combined multi-lever effects not evaluated
